text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Great Harvest Festival—a major milestone marking the end of these three years—had finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"I-Is this really okay...?
Rice isn't standing out too much, is she...?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
What're you being shy for? You're our poster girl!
Have some confidence and go stand out!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: D-Does it look weird anywhere, I wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, so cute!
The food is all ready too, so let's get going!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, come on, today only!
It's Big Sis's special pizza!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Limited quantity Sweepy Magical Pot-au-feu!
Eat up quickly, or it'll all be gone!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Curses... There are too many limited-edition items!
I'll take the right route! Tama, take the left
and gather the dishes from each team!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Ain't you looking
even more serious than during a race?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
We've got everything from sandwiches to ice cream...!
Please, have a bite!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Large portion, extra portion, Buono portion!
You can choose any toppings you like
to match whatever nutrition you need~!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
We also recreated the menu we all made for the Chairwoman the other day, in our own style!
I'd be so happy if you gave it a try...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... As expected of a food trend pioneer...!
The quality is incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"You've recreated that special menu from the other day
perfectly... I remember peeling the carrots
back then, you know."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Thriving! Acclaimed!
Truly the presence of a champion!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Chairwoman!
Are you completely feeling better now...!?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks to all of you!
And to prove it—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: (Grrr~)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Appetite at full throttle! Without further ado, may I have one as well?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
Um, well then—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a sec~!
Chairwoman, please have your first bite be
the Machitan family's secret recipe curry!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"No, no~ How about the special pot-au-feu
I made with Dober and Ryan-oneesama~?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"No, your first bite should be from my dish.
I have specially concocted a secret ingredient just for today, after all."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...If you intend to feed that to Madam Chairwoman,
try tasting it for poison yourself first.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, the Chairwoman is super popular...!
At this rate, we'll have to race to decide what order she eats them in!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I'm totally fine with going last, but...
Sure thing. You're an Umamusume, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Running anytime, anywhere, endlessly...
That is who we are, after all.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A-Alright...! Rice is gonna do her best so you eat mine first!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaa~~!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Everyone being so full of energy is splendid!
...Truly.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...This is bad. At this rate,
I might not be able to get anything into my stomach.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone continuing to run in good health.
My dream is right here, right before my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"With just this, I...
......"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Oops, that won't do! If we win and I end up not being able to eat anything, it'd be such a disappointment!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
This place is... alright!
I'll run here too and work up an appetite!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Hey, everyone! Let me join in too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And with Chairwoman Akikawa joining in, the Umamusume ran together.
Every single face was radiant, brimming with smiles of pure joy from the bottom of their hearts."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Far and wide, and forever on.
It felt as though we could run endlessly.
